app.name: Chorus
app.tagline: Work with several coding agents in one conversation, on your own machine.

conversation.projectPathPlaceholder: Leave empty to start in your home folder
conversation.readOnlyNotice: Agents start read-only. They ask before running or changing anything.
conversation.placeholder: Say something. Type @ to choose who answers.
conversation.addAgent: Bring {{agent}} in — it reads the conversation so far
conversation.nobodyHere: Nobody is in this conversation. Add an agent to start again.
conversation.restartLabel: Start this session over, with nothing said in it
conversation.endConfirm: An agent is working — press again to end this session

settings.heading: Settings
settings.paneNote: Agents, folder and permissions belong to each session — change them in its own bar. A new session starts where the last one was.

policy.heading: What agents may do without asking
policy.footnote: Anything a profile does not cover still asks. Slack, Jira and the like always ask.

logs.heading: What Chorus has been doing
logs.redactedHint: Secrets are removed as the log is written.
logs.exportHint: Writes a shareable file to your Desktop.

review.heading: Changes on disk
review.untrackedOnly: Only untracked files — nothing to diff yet.
review.source: Read from git, not from the transcript.

handoff.heading: Hand off
handoff.title: {{from}} → {{to}}
handoff.previewHint: Edit anything here before it is sent.
handoff.editedHint: Edited — this is what will be sent.
